### Heuristic format and eval methodology
from: [[wiki:heuristic-schema]] + [[decision:two-phase-eval-methodology]]
retrieved: 2026-05-27

- SCHEMA.md: 6 sections + YAML frontmatter (id, trigger, domain, source_phase, confidence, helpful: 0, harmful: 0, status). 3-heuristic cap, 1200-char combined, LLM matcher + domain-tag fallback.
- Two-phase eval: agent blind, separate judge. 3 runs per condition, delta >=0.5 meaningful. All conditions in same fresh round.
